details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: Rush. [fanfare] Bury an amulet: Give this Storm.

issues: The fanfare is encoded incorrectly as an unconditional buryFieldFollowers effect. It should be an optional-cost style fanfare that buries an amulet on your field and then gives this follower Storm.
The Storm granted by the fanfare is missing. Add a fanfare effect that, after burying an amulet, uses grantKeyword with keyword "storm" targeting self.
The bury target is wrong. Do not use buryFieldFollowers for an amulet; encode the cost as burying an ally field card filtered to cardType "amulet".

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Worldreaver's Descent & Dominion of Darkness"
details.effect: On Evolve - Put a Carbuncle's Sparkle token into your EX area. Give each Carbuncle's Sparkle in your EX area "This card costs 2 less to play."

issues: The second On Evolve clause is missing from the onEvolve ability. The On Evolve effect should be a sequence that both puts a Carbuncle's Sparkle token into your EX area and gives each Carbuncle's Sparkle in your EX area "This card costs 2 less to play."
The passive grantPlayCostReduction targeting self is incorrect. The cost reduction should apply to each card named Carbuncle's Sparkle in your EX area, not to this evolved follower.
